fieldValues.title: A dry queue looks like a stopped group: builders exit quietly, so the owner sees no work and no reason
fieldValues.summary: On 2026-10-30 the owner reported that all automated group work had stopped. Every group trigger was enabled and firing on schedule; pause checks were ok with budget room (10 and 6). Each builder run triaged for about two minutes and exited with nothing built, because no ready issue passed its checks: needs-input, a missing epic parent, RFC-only issues, a stale branch, a guard on a missing type. The brief says 'none means exit quietly', so the reasons stayed inside run logs no one reads.
evidence: RemoteTrigger list_runs for trig_01RC6KWkRKzVVsPQxzZWbWpF, trig_017sfYgXA1PXoZRmHDzG69Jz, trig_012AfuCV7TWkDpw7mHpCE2w5
fieldValues.body: The run already knows why each candidate was skipped; it just does not say so where the owner looks. A remedy would post the skip reasons per candidate to the desk (or the group's epic) when a run builds nothing, so a dry queue reads as a list of stops with owners.
